title.narrative: Envelop 1: Provision of integrated WASH and ERL services to the affected people in Northwest Syria

description.narrative:
Shafak is proposing to implement an integrated WASH and Early Recovery intervention that aims at addressing identified critical gaps and emergency essential needs in NWS. through promoting equitable access to quality WASH services and livelihoods provided for a total of 8582 HHs (42911 people: 9687 men, 10646 women, 10846 boys, 11732 girls, of them 2146 people with disabilities) in Azaz district (Aleppo), and Harim and Idleb districts (Idleb) in and off-camps.
- WASH:
Shafak intends to enhance the quality of and provide WASH services integrated with the existing and underfunded WASH projects to benefit 38,926 individuals (9702 women, 8801 men, 20423 children) in 23 camps located in Azaz and Akhtarin sub-districts in Aleppo, and Dana and Maaret Tamsrin sub-districts in Idleb, in addition to one community (Shammarin) in Azaz sub-district in Aleppo:
a) Expansion of sewerage systems (13383 m.l) through connecting 21 camps in Idleb and Aleppo to existing main pipelines, and rehabilitation of the sewage network (980 m.l) in Shamarin community in Aleppo. b) Expansion of water networks (3645 of m.l) by connecting 2 camps in Al-Dana sub-district to existing main pipelines, and expanding/replacing of the water network in Shamarin. c) Rehabilitation of 3 water pumping stations, establishing solar powered systems, providing operational support for 2-4 months, and construction of one high elevated water tank (60 m3) in Al-Dana sub-district. d) Garbage removal in 4 camps (3 in Azaz and 1 in Al-Dana sub-districts) for 5 months, e) Providing desludging services in 3 camps (in Al-Dana, Azaz and Akhtarin sub-districts) until finalizing the construction/rehabilitation of the sewage networks and septic tanks. f) Constructing 13 disaggregated latrines (1 for PwDs) and rehabilitating 8 latrines blocks in two camps in Azaz. g) Conducting hygiene promotion and distributing soap for 6,000 individuals in Harim, Idleb and A’zaz districts. The integration with ER component will be through enrollment of CFW workers for light rehabilitation, and debris/garbage removal activities.
- Early Recovery:
Shafak aims to support economic recovery and community resilience by providing a holistic set of activities promoting community participation and building the capacity of the communities’ members in Idleb and Harim districts (Idleb) and ensuring inclusion of different community groups ( men, women and PWDs of IDPs and host communities) through the following activities:
a) 300 HHs will be supported with emergency business grants (Cash grants) with value 500 USD distributed over two installments to recover from shocks. The grants will be provided by meeting the criteria, attending the training and submitting good business plan. We will have 3 types of targeted beneficiaries: 1.Businesses affected by the earthquake (200 business) 2.Businesses supported previously to establish businesses under previous project (100 business) 3.Businesses that will be established in the new constructed market in Hatten camp (8 Businesses)
b) 625 HHs will be supported with one CFW round (20 days) with daily wages of $6 (unskilled) and $7 (skilled) based on the labour market survey and CWG recommendations. CFW activities will be based on the community initiatives, EQ response with integration with WASH activities (e.g. light rehabilitation, debris/garbage removal) and other activities integrated with shelter (e.g. fixing tents, snow removal) c) 200 HHs will be supported with 3 rounds of CFW (60 days) enrolling them to in-job training activity or apprenticeships, based on the labor requests received through labour needs assessment or online requests from private sector and local entities. d) Establish one market (8 shops 16 M2 each) in Hantuteen camp, Harim district, in Idleb complementing other Shafak’s WASH and shelter activities and improving access to markets and livelihoods. The shops will be handed over to the selected SMEs beneficiaries.
